html:
SMTO-EXE-0275 — The screen changed before SMTO could click

GUID: f8b78311-75eb-56cf-80a4-a730078e21cd
Slug: ui-visual-target-stale
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO was about to click or type at a spot it found in a screenshot, but that part of the screen moved or changed, or the screenshot got too old. SMTO didn't send the click or typing.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Don't move, resize or scroll the window on the Gateway's computer while SMTO is working in it. SMTO clicks only if the area around the target still looks exactly like its screenshot.
  2. Ask SMTO in the conversation to take a new screenshot and find the target again. A screenshot can be used for only about two minutes, and only until the next click or key press.
  3. If the target blinks or moves, such as a blinking typing line or a spinning loading icon, ask SMTO to use the button or field by its name instead. Moving pixels near the target make every new screenshot look different.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's click or typing lands on the intended spot and the app responds as expected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with a note about what was on the screen. Don't let SMTO repeat a click whose result you haven't checked.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Guarded visual input was refused before dispatch because the screen capture record expired (120 s), was invalidated by later input, belongs to another run, or the fresh recapture's geometry, window ownership or target pixels (box plus 16 px margin) no longer match.

What this means

  • Visual desktop target is stale. Capture the current target again with geometry_version=2, locate it, and deliberately choose the next action. Do not replay uncertain input.

Why this can happen

  • Visual desktop target is stale.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect fresh capture geometry, surface identity and focus.

How to fix it

  • Recapture the same scope with geometry_version=2, locate the target again with vision.locate, and send a new action using the fresh visual_target. For animated or blinking targets choose a stable region or a semantic ui action; never replay uncertain input.
  • Capture the current target again with geometry_version=2, locate it, and deliberately choose the next action. Do not replay uncertain input.

Retry and execution caution

  • Capture the current target again with geometry_version=2, locate it, and deliberately choose the next action. Do not replay uncertain input.

How to verify the fix

  • Fresh evidence establishes the requested outcome.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, read secure fields, record input or bypass OS permissions.

Technical notes

  • Only the existing explicit UI request may observe or mutate the selected desktop. Secure values stay redacted, stale references are not retargeted, and uncertain native input is not automatically repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
